# `web_traffic`

**Layer:** **synthetic** — generated by `scripts/synth/generate.py` for demonstration. Every answer that reads this table must say so (`V2-SYN-4`). Dates span 2016-09-01 to 2018-10-31.

Daily web sessions and conversion per customer state.

**Grain:** state x day.

## Columns

| Column | Meaning | Unit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date` | Day. | date |
| `state` | Real customer state code. | text |
| `sessions` | Sessions. | count |
| `conversion_rate` | Orders per session. | ratio 0-1 |
| `boleto_share` | Share of checkouts choosing boleto. | ratio 0-1 |

## Join keys

- `web_traffic.state = customers.customer_state`

## Caveats

- Conversion rate is session-weighted when aggregated: `SUM(sessions * conversion_rate) / SUM(sessions)`.
